description: Service split for the pagerduty provider. Every operation is assigned to a service by its first OpenAPI tag through the `tags` map (tag -> service); `pathRules` are evaluated first and override the tag for the listed paths. Used by bin/split.mjs and provider-dev/scripts/build_inventory.mjs via lib/spec_helpers.mjs. An operation whose tag is not in the map fails the run without writing.

descriptions.abilities: Account abilities by feature name (for example teams), which depend on the pricing plan and account state.
descriptions.add_ons: Add-ons let developers insert their own functionality into the PagerDuty UI.
descriptions.alert_grouping_settings: Alert grouping settings define how alerts on a service are grouped into incidents.
descriptions.analytics: Enriched incident, responder and user analytics data (POST-based reads exposed as SELECT).
descriptions.automation_actions: Automation Actions: actions, runners, invocations and their service and team associations.
descriptions.business_services: Business services model the services an organization provides, their subscribers, impacts and priority thresholds.
descriptions.change_events: Change events represent changes (deployments, configuration changes) correlated with incidents.
descriptions.custom_fields: Account-level custom field definitions for incidents (deprecated in favour of incident types) and services.
descriptions.enrichment: Contextual data enrichment: ServiceNow integrations, enrichment schemas and records, and event enrichments.
descriptions.escalation_policies: Escalation policies determine who is notified and when for incidents on a service.
descriptions.event_orchestrations: Event Orchestrations route, enrich and act on events (global, router, unrouted and service paths, integrations, cache variables, enablements).
descriptions.extension_schemas: Extension schemas describe the available extension types (vendors and webhook types).
descriptions.extensions: Extensions attach extension schema objects (webhooks, integrations) to services.
descriptions.incident_types: Incident types and their custom fields.
descriptions.incident_workflows: Incident Workflows, their actions, triggers and instances.
descriptions.incidents: Incidents and their alerts, notes, log entries, status updates, responder requests, custom field values and business service impacts.
descriptions.licenses: Licenses and license allocations for the account.
descriptions.log_entries: Log entries record everything that happens to an incident.
descriptions.maintenance_windows: Maintenance windows temporarily disable incident creation on services.
descriptions.notifications: Notifications sent to users for incidents in a time window.
descriptions.on_calls: On-calls: who is on call for which escalation policy and schedule.
descriptions.paused_incident_reports: Reports on alerts whose incident notifications were paused.
descriptions.priorities: Incident priorities configured on the account.
descriptions.rulesets: Rulesets and event rules (legacy event rules; superseded by Event Orchestrations).
descriptions.schedules: On-call schedules, their overrides, users and audit records.
descriptions.schedules_v3: The v3 schedules API: schedules, rotations, events, custom shifts and overrides.
descriptions.service_dependencies: Dependencies between business services and technical services.
descriptions.services: Technical services, their integrations, event rules, custom field values, feature enablements and audit records.
descriptions.status_dashboards: Status dashboards and their service impacts.
descriptions.status_pages: Status pages: impacts, services, severities, statuses, posts, post updates, postmortems and subscriptions.
descriptions.tags: Tags and the entities they are applied to.
descriptions.teams: Teams, their members, escalation policies, notification subscriptions and audit records.
descriptions.templates: Message templates (status updates and other templated content).
descriptions.users: Users and their contact methods, notification rules, subscriptions, sessions, licenses and OAuth delegations.
descriptions.vendors: Vendors are integration types (AWS CloudWatch, Splunk, Datadog).
descriptions.webhooks: Webhook subscriptions (v3 webhooks) and their OAuth clients.
